name: useful-system-monitor
description: See what's using up your Mac — and close the apps that are hogging it. CPU, memory, disk and battery at a glance, right in your terminal.

scripts.bench: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo build --release && npm run build && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo run -q --release -p sysmon-harness --bin bench -- --runs 9
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run verify:versions && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.screenshot:svg: FORCE_COLOR=3 COLS=100 ROWS=36 tsx scripts/gen-svg.tsx docs/screenshot.svg
scripts.screenshot:svg:battery: FORCE_COLOR=3 COLS=100 ROWS=30 tsx scripts/gen-svg.tsx docs/battery.svg 4
scripts.verify:diff: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo build && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo run -q -p sysmon-harness --bin diff -- --samples 5
scripts.verify:frames: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo build --release -p sysmon && npm run build && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo run -q --release -p sysmon-harness --bin frame_diff
scripts.verify:longrun:rust: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo build --release -p sysmon && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo run -q -p sysmon-harness --bin verify_longrun -- --secs 120
scripts.verify:rust: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo fmt --all --check && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo clippy --all-targets && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo test
scripts.verify:tui:rust: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo build && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo run -q -p sysmon-harness --bin verify_tui -- --mock

author: Ziwei Wu (https://github.com/ziweiwu)
